==Transportation==
As there is no grouping teleport for this minigame, the fastest methods are:

* [[Volcanic mine teleport]] (purchased at [[Petrified Pete's Ore Shop]])
* [[Digsite pendant]] to the [[Digsite]], travel to [[Fossil Island]] via the barge, then go East and climb up the [[Rope anchor]] (requires {{SCP|Agility|64}})
* [[Digsite pendant]] to [[House on the Hill]], then [[Mycelium Transportation System]] to [[Verdant Valley]], then run east below the lava, then run north
